RecommendationDescription: Resize an underutilized virtual machine from a1-standard-8 to a1-standard-4 based on sustained low CPU utilization.
Purchase a one-year all-upfront resource reservation to cover steady-state compute usage currently billed at on-demand rates.
Delete an unattached block storage volume with no recorded input or output operations in the preceding 30 days.
Restrict public network access on an object storage bucket that is currently readable by anonymous principals.
Enable multi-zone redundancy on a production database instance to remove a single point of failure.
Migrate a virtual machine to a current-generation instance family offering a lower rate for equivalent capacity.
Enable content delivery caching in front of a web application to reduce origin response latency.
Apply the organization's required cost allocation tags to resources that are currently missing them.
